description: Makes pictures in the project's look, as many as asked, from an idea and/or products. Marsell's writer writes each picture's prompt from the idea, and the picture model makes it: both are charged, the writing at about what it has cost this project and the picture at the price of the picture model the owner chose, and the quote gives each part. For a picture from a finished prompt of your own, use picture_make: the prompt goes as you wrote it, nothing is written, and it costs the picture alone. Without confirm: true it only quotes the price; with it, it starts making them. They land in Create, where the owner posts each on its planned day or keeps it in their library (two presses: keeping one posts nothing); for a channel with no account connected the first press keeps it as a draft for that day, and nothing is scheduled or posted. A picture that must show a little-known real place, a venue, an artwork or a named person as it truly is is made from a real photograph of it (a place the whole world can picture is made as any picture); when none can be trusted, it waits in Create for a photo from the owner instead of being invented. The owner is asked once per place, and Marsell looks again every ten minutes for free: once a photo of it arrives (get_upload_link, kind picture, captioned with the place), the waiting pictures are made from it. The business's own characters and places (get_brand lists them) are made from their own pictures, in the look the idea calls for, when the idea has them in it. A character with two or more pictures and no reference sheet yet has that sheet made first, once, at about one more picture: the quote names it (reference_sheets_first).

confirm.description: true to spend the tokens and make them; otherwise a quote.

count.description: How many pictures, 1 or more; 2 when left out. The quote grows with it.

idea.description: What the pictures show, in a sentence.

product_ids.description: Products to feature, by their ids in get_brand's products.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

name: make_pictures
title: Make pictures for the business
